description: The line plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 model layers for four distinct components: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dash-dot line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks at every 5 layers. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. All four lines remain near zero until layer 5, after which they exhibit sharp increases: attn_output rises to ~1200 by layer 6 and then declines; attn_residual peaks at ~1500 by layer 6 and remains high until layer 21 before dropping; ffn_output surges to ~1200 at layer 6, drops to near zero by layer 8, spikes again to ~1200 at layer 13, then falls and rises again to ~1200 at layer 22; ffn_residual jumps to ~1400 at layer 5, plateaus near 1500 through layer 20, then drops sharply to ~400 at layer 22. The plot visually confirms the caption’s claim that the baseline configuration exhibits massive activations and attention sinks emerging after the 6th layer, as evidenced by the sustained high values and abrupt drops across multiple components.
